claim: In 2025 EUV (NXE+EXE) accounted for about 47.4% of ASML's EUR 24,474.3 million net system sales, ArF immersion about 42.1%, KrF + ArF dry + i-line together about 7.1%, and metrology & inspection about 3.4%.
evidence: Computed from p. 280 'Net system sales per technology' (2025, EUR m): EXE 1,156.9; NXE 10,445.8; ArF immersion 10,311.4; ArF dry 427.0; KrF 1,001.3; I-line 307.3; Metrology & Inspection 824.6; Total 24,474.3.
notes: Fact-check correction of CLM-1648: the legacy DUV share (KrF+ArF dry+i-line = 1,735.6/24,474.3 = 7.09%) is slightly above, not under, 7%. Inference from CLM-1640, CLM-1641, CLM-1642, CLM-1643, CLM-1644, CLM-1645.
